recommendations.title: Stabilize dispersal gate flow
recommendations.rationale: Parent experience facts or gate events indicate dispersal congestion.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Open Gate 2 for overflow pickup and assign a floor coordinator for the dispersal window.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Reduce dispersal congestion minutes and improve parent experience score.

recommendations.title: Close teacher supervision gaps
recommendations.rationale: Teacher productivity score or supervision gap events are below target.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Audit period-by-period teacher presence against timetable for affected rooms.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Improve teacher productivity and academic operations scores.

recommendations.title: Restore critical camera coverage
recommendations.rationale: Compliance module or camera offline events need remediation.
recommendations.suggestedAction: Dispatch IT to restore offline critical cameras and verify stream health in AI Health.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Lift compliance score and reduce safety blind spots.
